REQUIREMENT:
Author's description of the change: "play button: cd into the workspace before running the command"
Author's comment in the change: "Prefix a cd into the workspace so the command always runs in the correct directory."

CODE:
diff --git a/frontend/dist/app.js b/frontend/dist/app.js
@@ -3,6 +3,11 @@ document.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
   const code = ev.target.closest("[data-run-command]");
   if (!code) return;
   const command = commandFromFence(code.textContent);
+  // Prefix a cd into the workspace so the command always runs in the
+  // correct directory. JSON.stringify quotes the path "safely".
+  const wsPath = (window.Panels && typeof window.Panels.workspace === "function") ? window.Panels.workspace() : "";
+  const full = wsPath ? 'cd ' + JSON.stringify(wsPath) + ' && ' + command : command;
   Panels.setOpen(true);
-  Panels.select("terminal", { command });
+  // The terminal panel writes the string verbatim to its persistent POSIX sh.
+  Panels.select("terminal", { command: full });
 });

RECORDED EXECUTION RESULTS (isolated POSIX /bin/sh in a pinned container; the shell's user is not root):
--- CHANGED CODE, input: workspace path `/tmp/ws$dir` (a directory of exactly that literal name exists), command `pwd`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd "/tmp/ws$dir" && pwd
setup before it: mkdir -p '/tmp/ws$dir'
exit code: 2
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: ''
stderr: "/tmp/__kai_run.sh: cd: line 1: can't cd to /tmp/ws: No such file or directory\n"
--- CHANGED CODE, input: workspace path `/tmp/ws`back`` (exists literally), command `pwd`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd "/tmp/ws`back`" && pwd
setup before it: mkdir -p '/tmp/ws`back`'
exit code: 2
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: ''
stderr: "/tmp/__kai_run.sh: line 0: back: not found\n/tmp/__kai_run.sh: cd: line 1: can't cd to /tmp/ws: No such file or directory\n"
--- PROPOSED REMEDY (single-quote escaper), input `/tmp/ws$dir`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd '/tmp/ws$dir' && pwd
setup before it: mkdir -p '/tmp/ws$dir'
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp/ws$dir
stdout: '/tmp/ws$dir\n'
stderr: ''
--- PROPOSED REMEDY (single-quote escaper), input `/tmp/ws`back``
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd '/tmp/ws`back`' && pwd
setup before it: mkdir -p '/tmp/ws`back`'
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp/ws`back`
stdout: '/tmp/ws`back`\n'
stderr: ''
--- PROPOSED REMEDY (single-quote escaper), input /bad/missing/path (does not exist), command `echo COMMAND_RAN`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd '/bad/missing/path' && echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: (none)
exit code: 2
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: ''
stderr: "/tmp/__kai_run.sh: cd: line 1: can't cd to /bad/missing/path: No such file or directory\n"

ALLEGED VIOLATION:
frontend/dist/app.js:8 — `JSON.stringify` double-quoting is not fully POSIX-safe for paths containing `$`, backticks, or `\`; the "safely" comment overstates it.
JSON.stringify wraps the path in double quotes, but `$` and backticks remain special inside POSIX sh double quotes. A path like `/tmp/ws$dir` expands `$dir` to empty; a path like `/tmp/ws`back`` triggers command substitution. The 'safely' comment is incorrect for these metacharacters.

PROPOSED REMEDY:
Replace JSON.stringify with single-quote POSIX escaping: wrap the path in single quotes and replace each embedded single quote with `'\''`. For example: `"'" + wsPath.replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'"`.
